An agency may manage several client campaigns at once.

storySections.title: Instagram Views for Australian Local Businesses
paragraphs: Reels can be particularly useful for local businesses because video can quickly show what the company actually does.

A restaurant might show a dish being prepared. An interior designer might show a completed room. A builder might show a project transformation. A salon might show a finished result. A retailer might showcase new stock. A real estate business might walk through a property. A tourism business might show a destination or experience.
If you're supporting these videos with Views, make sure the account also includes accurate local and contact information.
storySections.footer: Visible attention can strengthen presentation. The real business behind the Reel builds trust.

storySections.title: Use Views Alongside Genuine Customer Proof
paragraphs: Views can add visible activity to a Reel. They are not the same as genuine customer proof.

Businesses can strengthen trust through authentic reviews, real testimonials, genuine project examples, customer-created content, case studies, tagged customer posts, accurate business information and real customer comments.
Don't invent customer experiences simply to make a campaign look stronger. If your business has genuine proof, use it alongside your strongest video content.
storySections.footer: Views support presentation. Real customer experience supports credibility.
